LegalReasonBench · figures and tables for design

18 figures and 20 tables, the set the publication write-up keeps (10/15 tab)

Each item below is a figure or table that the write-up calls out in a bracketed reference, in the order the write-up uses. The label over each item repeats that reference word for word, with the write-up section it sits in. Nothing else from the report is included.

Every number is copied unchanged from the report posted on 10/14 at 11:17pm ET, which the write-up's figures reference, and every chart is drawn from the same data. Charts are interactive: hover for exact values and 95% intervals. Gemini 4 Argon* carries an asterisk throughout because it was added after the other seven models had run, and answered newer versions of 17 of the 50 matters. The head-to-head table (Table 5) compares models only on matters where both answered the same version.

The orange-highlighted boxes carry the write-up's own notes to design, what changed from the 10/14 tab, and three chart axes widened since the 10/14 report because they cut off data. No number changed.

Agent working time sums, over a matter's assignments, the span from the first to the last step of the agent's trajectory: the time the model is thinking, calling tools and writing. End-to-end time runs from run start to run completion and adds sandbox setup, the transfer of files between assignments, queueing for a worker and grading by the panel. Wall-clock time depends on provider load on the run dates and is not a property of the model alone.
